panels.title: Available RAM
panels.description:
RAM that Android currently considers available for new work.

Units: Bytes, shown as MiB or GiB; sampled from availMem at each collection.

[Read more](/d/ahwotel-help-en?viewPanel=panel-1)

panels.title: Free storage
panels.description:
Free space that ordinary applications can use on the filesystem containing AHWOTel data.

Units: Bytes, displayed as MiB or GiB; sampled from StatFs.availableBytes.

[Read more](/d/ahwotel-help-en?viewPanel=panel-2)

panels.title: Probe CPU wait
panels.description:
Time that the dedicated probe thread was ready to execute but waited in the CPU run queue between two probes.

Units: Milliseconds accumulated over the measured interval

[Read more](/d/ahwotel-help-en?viewPanel=panel-3)

panels.title: Probe scheduling delay
panels.description:
How late the probe thread actually starts compared with its scheduled execution time.

Units: Milliseconds of lateness per probe, measured with monotonic uptime

[Read more](/d/ahwotel-help-en?viewPanel=panel-4)

panels.title: System CPU, when supported
panels.description:
Share of total CPU time spent busy across the device during the interval between two readings.

Units: Percent, 0–100

[Read more](/d/ahwotel-help-en?viewPanel=panel-5)

panels.title: Thermal status
panels.description:
Android thermal throttling status for the device, rather than a temperature in degrees.

Units: Codes: 0 none, 1 light, 2 moderate, 3 severe, 4 critical, 5 emergency, 6…
